title: v0.4 bounded behavior, anatomy and population admission assessment
scope: 56 registry task-resource pairings across A,B,C,E,F,G,J; source assessment plus three prepared real-data endpoints and existing C05 execution evidence. Not56independentdatasets or56executedbenchmarks.

definitions.ready: Prepared executable adapter with acquisition/split/scorer provenance, or existing C05 measured implementation. Does not mean current SOTA verified.
definitions.source_only: Plausible resource retained; concrete acquisition, annotation, split, scorer or interface gates unresolved. Not a negative judgment of dataset quality.
definitions.deferred: Excluded from current execution release for stated resource, data-use or protocol burden. Not universally impossible.

review_limitations: This is a bounded admission audit and retrospective logging of this extension, not an exhaustive or PRISMA-compliant systematic review.
Most source-only entries were assessed from already-mapped primary protocols without downloading their data; no unattempted access is reported as a confirmed failure.
Reasons explain current research-compute/interface scope; another budget or modality-specific runner may admit additional entries.
Central registry and results remain authoritative for evolving execution status; presence of result files is captured only at integration.
Only A09,A14,E01 data preparation is independently verified in this extension. Existing C05 records were not rerun by this bounded audit.
Anatomy image tracing/registration has no prepared endpoint in this audit. SWC-only statistics, predicted masks and pseudo-labels were not substituted for image-groundtruth tasks.
